case: reflects a new live-preview value on re-render without requiring a full page reload
why: It renders published content, then rerenders with edited getContentByKey values and asserts the anchor's href changed to the new preview value, which would fail if the component did not update without a full page reload.
vc: When a content author edits a field value in the Contentstack Live Preview sidebar, the corresponding text on the page updates to display the edited value without requiring a full page reload.

why: The test file exclusively tests ContentstackLink (href and title updates), with no tests exercising image fields, tags, or image src attributes.
vc: When a content author changes an image field in the Contentstack Live Preview sidebar, the corresponding image on the page updates to display the newly selected image without requiring a full page reload.

why: The re-render test only asserts that href updates without page reload, but no test re-renders and asserts that display text (title/aria-label) also updates without reload, so a violation where display text specifically fails to update on re-render would not be caught.
vc: When a content author modifies a link's URL or display text in the Contentstack Live Preview sidebar, the rendered link on the page reflects the updated URL and display text without requiring a full page reload.

why: The test file exercises ContentstackLink (anchor href and aria-label), not a card component, so no test asserts that a card's title or description text updates on re-render without a page reload.
vc: When a content author edits a card's title or description in the Contentstack Live Preview sidebar, the rendered card on the page displays the updated title and description text without requiring a full page reload.

case: falls back to published content when livePreview is undefined (production)
why: This test uses the real useContent hook with no livePreview in context and asserts getContentByKey returns the published value, so it would fail if the published-content fallback were broken when preview is inactive.
vc: When the Contentstack Live Preview connection is unavailable or the preview session is not active, the page renders the last published content without error and without blank or missing content areas.

case: renders published content with no live-preview indicators when preview is not active
why: The test asserts the rendered anchor has no `data-cslp` attribute (a Live Preview indicator) and renders static published content, so it would fail if Live Preview indicators were injected on a production page.
vc: On a production page with no Contentstack Live Preview session active, the page renders all content as static published content with no visible Live Preview indicators, editable overlays, or real-time update behavior.

why: The test file exclusively tests a single ContentstackLink component and never renders a card list, so no assertion verifies that adding, removing, or reordering cards is reflected without a page reload.
vc: When a content author adds, removes, or reorders cards in a card list via the Contentstack Live Preview sidebar, the rendered card list on the page reflects the updated set and order of cards without requiring a full page reload.
